verdict.rationale: Granular selection is possible, but mostly at the plugin level. The anthropics/skills marketplace offers separate plugins (`document-skills`, `example-skills`) rather than one monolithic bundle, and the API lets you pick individual skills by `skill_id` per request (up to 20). However, the Claude Code install path documented here installs grouped plugins, not single skills, and bundled skills can only be turned off all at once via `disableBundledSkills`. Missing for 10: documented per-skill install from a marketplace collection in Claude Code, per-skill enable/disable of bundled skills, and hands-on corroboration of a selective install workflow.
